hebrewText: וְ/קוֹרֵ֨א בֶן יִמְנָ֤ה הַ/לֵּוִי֙ הַ/שּׁוֹעֵ֣ר לַ/מִּזְרָ֔חָ/ה עַ֖ל נִדְב֣וֹת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים לָ/תֵת֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/קָדְשֵׁ֖י הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים

tokens.bdb: Kore, the name of two Israelites
a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
